brief: Explain why low income can leave a deficit even after discretionary purchases are removed.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "When cuts cannot close the gap"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Cuando recortar no basta"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Quando cortar não basta"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Explain why low income can leave a deficit even after discretionary purchases are removed.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Check whether essential costs exceed income before proposing more cuts.
instruction.misconception: Assuming every shortfall can be eliminated by stopping discretionary purchases.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.
